text: No fire was detected on the asset during the evaluated period (2026-09-25 to 2026-10-24). NASA FIRMS data showed zero thermal anomalies intersecting the asset from all sensors (MODIS, VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21). However, the last day (2026-10-25) had insufficient coverage due to data gaps. While no fires were detected, small or short-lived fires could have gone unnoticed. The evidence does not confirm the absence of burned areas or fires outside the evaluated period.
